attributes.name: Modulus
attributes.description: The modulus of the operation. Must be non-zero.

attributes.name: MotionDetected
attributes.description: Has the item currently detected movement. Intended to be used by StatusEffect conditionals (setting this value in XML has no effect).

attributes.name: Target
attributes.description: Which kind of targets can trigger the sensor?

attributes.name: TargetCharacters
attributes.description: Does the sensor react only to certain characters (species names, groups or tags)? Doesn't have an effect, if the Target Type is incorrect.

attributes.name: IgnoreDead
attributes.description: Should the sensor ignore the bodies of dead characters?

attributes.name: RangeX
attributes.description: Horizontal detection range.

attributes.name: RangeY
attributes.description: Vertical movement detection range.

attributes.name: DetectOffset
attributes.description: The position to detect the movement at relative to the item. For example, 0,100 would detect movement 100 units above the item.

attributes.name: UpdateInterval
attributes.description: How often the sensor checks if there's something moving near it. Higher values are better for performance.

attributes.name: MaxOutputLength
attributes.description: The maximum length of the output strings. Warning: Large values can lead to large memory usage or networking issues.

attributes.name: Output
attributes.description: The signal the item outputs when it has detected movement.

attributes.name: FalseOutput
attributes.description: The signal the item outputs when it has not detected movement.

attributes.name: MinimumVelocity
attributes.description: How fast the objects within the detector's range have to be moving (in m/s).

attributes.name: DetectOwnMotion
attributes.description: Should the sensor trigger when the item itself moves.

attributes.name: WrittenName
attributes.description: Name written on the tag.

components.notes: 无用途说明句；继承（also supports）：ItemComponent

attributes.name: ContinuousOutput
attributes.description: When enabled, the component continuously outputs "1" when it's not receiving a signal.

attributes.name: OutputType
attributes.description: What kind of a signal the item outputs. Pulse: periodically sends out a signal of 1. Sawtooth: sends out a periodic wave that increases linearly from 0 to 1. Sine: sends out a sine wave oscillating be...

attributes.name: Frequency
attributes.description: How fast the signal oscillates, or how fast the pulses are sent (in Hz).

attributes.name: Stuck
attributes.description: How badly stuck the door is (in percentages). If the percentage reaches 100, the door needs to be cut open to make it usable again.

attributes.name: OpeningSpeed
attributes.description: How quickly the door opens.

attributes.name: ClosingSpeed
attributes.description: How quickly the door closes.

attributes.name: ToggleCoolDown
attributes.description: The door cannot be opened/closed during this time after it has been opened/closed by another character.

attributes.name: Window
attributes.description: Position and size of the window on the door. The upper left corner is 0,0. Set the width and height to 0 if you don't want the door to have a window.

attributes.name: IsOpen
attributes.description: Is the door currently open.

attributes.name: HasIntegratedButtons
attributes.description: If the door has integrated buttons, it can be opened by interacting with it directly (instead of using buttons wired to it).

attributes.name: ToggleWhenClicked
attributes.description: If the door has integrated buttons, should clicking on it perform the default action of opening the door? Can be used in conjunction with the "activate_out" output to pass a signal to a circuit withou...

attributes.name: Impassable
attributes.description: Characters and items cannot pass through impassable doors. Useful for things such as ducts that should only let water and air through.

attributes.name: BotsShouldKeepOpen
attributes.description: If true, bots won't try to close this door behind them.

components.notes: 无用途说明句；继承（also supports）：Pickable、ItemComponent

attributes.name: CanPush
attributes.description: Is the item currently able to push characters around? True by default. Only valid if blocksplayers is set to true.

attributes.name: Attached
attributes.description: Is the item currently attached to a wall (only valid if Attachable is set to true).

attributes.name: Aimable
attributes.description: Can the item be pointed to a specific direction or do the characters always hold it in a static pose.

attributes.name: CameraAimOffset
attributes.description: Camera offset to apply when aiming this item. Only valid if Aimable is set to true.

attributes.name: ControlPose
attributes.description: Should the character adjust its pose when aiming with the item. Most noticeable underwater, where the character will rotate its entire body to face the direction the item is aimed at.

attributes.name: UseHandRotationForHoldAngle
attributes.description: Use the hand rotation instead of torso rotation for the item hold angle. Enable this if you want the item just to follow with the arm when not aiming instead of forcing the arm to a hold pose.

attributes.name: Attachable
attributes.description: Can the item be attached to walls.

attributes.name: Reattachable
attributes.description: Can the item be reattached to walls after it has been deattached (only valid if Attachable is set to true).

attributes.name: LimitedAttachable
attributes.description: Can the item only be attached in limited amount? Uses permanent stat values to check for legibility.

attributes.name: AttachesToFloor
attributes.description: When enabled, the item can only be attached to a position where it touches the floor.

attributes.name: AllowAttachInsideDoors
attributes.description: Can the item be attached inside doors?

attributes.name: AttachedByDefault
attributes.description: Should the item be attached to a wall by default when it's placed in the submarine editor.

attributes.name: HoldPos
attributes.description: The position the character holds the item at (in pixels, as an offset from the character's shoulder). For example, a value of 10,-100 would make the character hold the item 100 pixels below the should...

attributes.name: AimPos
attributes.description: The position the character holds the item at when aiming (in pixels, as an offset from the character's shoulder). Works similarly as HoldPos, except that the position is rotated according to the direc...

attributes.name: DisableWhenRangedWeaponEquipped
attributes.description: If true, this item can't be used if the character is also holding a ranged weapon.

attributes.name: SpriteDepthWhenDropped
attributes.description: Sprite depth that's used when the item is NOT attached to a wall.

attributes.name: MsgWhenDropped
attributes.description: A text displayed next to the item when it's been dropped on the floor (not attached to a wall).

components.notes: 无用途说明句；继承（also supports）：Pickable、ItemComponent

attributes.name: Range
attributes.description: An estimation of how close the item has to be to the target for it to hit. Used by AI characters to determine when they're close enough to hit a target.

attributes.name: Reload
attributes.description: How long the user has to wait before they can hit with the weapon again (in seconds).

attributes.name: AllowHitMultiple
attributes.description: Can the weapon hit multiple targets per swing.

attributes.name: HitOnlyCharacters
attributes.description: Disable to make the weapon ignore all hit effects when it collides with walls, doors, or other items.

components.notes: 无用途说明句；继承（also supports）：Holdable、Pickable、ItemComponent

attributes.name: ThrowForce
attributes.description: The impulse applied to the physics body of the item when thrown. Higher values make the item be thrown faster.

attributes.name: FertilizerCapacity
attributes.description: How much fertilizer can the planter hold.

attributes.name: AllowUseWhenWorn
attributes.description: Can the item be used (assuming it has components that are usable in some way) when worn.

attributes.name: MinVoltage
attributes.description: The minimum voltage required for the device to function. The voltage is calculated as power / powerconsumption, meaning that a device with a power consumption of 1000 kW would need at least 500 kW of...

attributes.name: PowerConsumption
attributes.description: How much power the device draws (or attempts to draw) from the electrical grid when active.

attributes.name: IsActive
attributes.description: Is the device currently active. Inactive devices don't consume power.

attributes.name: CurrPowerConsumption
attributes.description: The current power consumption of the device. Intended to be used by StatusEffect conditionals (setting the value from XML is not recommended).

attributes.name: Voltage
attributes.description: The current voltage of the item (calculated as power consumption / available power). Intended to be used by StatusEffect conditionals (setting the value from XML is not recommended).

attributes.name: VulnerableToEMP
attributes.description: Can the item be damaged by electomagnetic pulses.

attributes.name: Range
attributes.description: How far the discharge can travel from the item.

attributes.name: RangeMultiplierInWalls
attributes.description: How much further can the discharge be carried when moving across walls.

attributes.name: Duration
attributes.description: The duration of an individual discharge (in seconds).

attributes.name: OutdoorsOnly
attributes.description: If set to true, the discharge cannot travel inside the submarine nor shock anyone inside.

components.notes: 无用途说明句；继承（also supports）：Powered、ItemComponent

attributes.name: MaxForce
attributes.description: The amount of force exerted on the submarine when the engine is operating at full power.

attributes.name: PropellerPos
attributes.description: The position of the propeller as an offset from the item's center (in pixels). Determines where the particles spawn and the position that causes characters to take damage from the engine if the Propel...

无用途说明句；继承（also supports）：Powered、ItemComponent

attributes.name: Range
attributes.description: The range of the emitted light. Higher values are more performance-intensive.

attributes.name: CastShadows
attributes.description: Should structures cast shadows when light from this light source hits them. Disabling shadows increases the performance of the game, and is recommended for lights with a short range. Lights that are s...

attributes.name: DrawBehindSubs
attributes.description: Lights drawn behind submarines don't cast any shadows and are much faster to draw than shadow-casting lights. It's recommended to enable this on decorative lights outside the submarine's hull.

attributes.name: IsOn
attributes.description: Is the light currently on.

attributes.name: Flicker
attributes.description: How heavily the light flickers. 0 = no flickering, 1 = the light will alternate between completely dark and full brightness.

attributes.name: FlickerSpeed
attributes.description: How fast the light flickers.

attributes.name: PulseFrequency
attributes.description: How rapidly the light pulsates (in Hz). 0 = no blinking.

attributes.name: PulseAmount
attributes.description: How much light pulsates (in Hz). 0 = not at all, 1 = alternates between full brightness and off.

attributes.name: BlinkFrequency
attributes.description: How rapidly the light blinks on and off (in Hz). 0 = no blinking.

attributes.name: LightColor
attributes.description: The color of the emitted light (R,G,B,A).

attributes.name: IgnoreContinuousToggle
attributes.description: If enabled, the component will ignore continuous signals received in the toggle input (i.e. a continuous signal will only toggle it once).

attributes.name: AlphaBlend
attributes.description: Should the light sprite be drawn on the item using alpha blending, in addition to being rendered in the light map? Can be used to make the light sprite stand out more.

attributes.name: LightOffset
attributes.description: Offset of the light from the position of the item (in pixels).

attributes.name: LightSpriteScale
attributes.description: The scale of the light sprite.

components.notes: 无用途说明句；继承（also supports）：Powered、ItemComponent

attributes.name: RequireWaterDetectors
attributes.description: Does the machine require inputs from water detectors in order to show the water levels inside rooms.

attributes.name: RequireOxygenDetectors
attributes.description: Does the machine require inputs from oxygen detectors in order to show the oxygen levels inside rooms.

attributes.name: ShowHullIntegrity
attributes.description: Should damaged walls be displayed by the machine.

attributes.name: EnableHullStatus
attributes.description: Enable hull status mode.

attributes.name: EnableElectricalView
attributes.description: Enable electrical view mode.

attributes.name: EnableItemFinder
attributes.description: Enable item finder mode.

attributes.name: IsUsableOutsidePlayerSub
attributes.description: If this item is portable, should it be usable outside the player submarine?

components.notes: 无用途说明句；继承（also supports）：Powered、ItemComponent

attributes.name: GeneratedAmount
attributes.description: How much oxygen the machine generates when operating at full power.

components.notes: 无用途说明句；继承（also supports）：Powered、ItemComponent

attributes.name: IndicatorPosition
attributes.description: The position of the progress bar indicating the charge of the item. In pixels as an offset from the upper left corner of the sprite.

attributes.name: IndicatorSize
attributes.description: The size of the progress bar indicating the charge of the item (in pixels).

attributes.name: IsHorizontal
attributes.description: Should the progress bar indicating the charge of the item fill up horizontally or vertically.

attributes.name: MaxOutPut
attributes.description: Maximum output of the device when fully charged (kW).

attributes.name: Capacity
attributes.description: The maximum capacity of the device (kW * min). For example, a value of 1000 means the device can output 100 kilowatts of power for 10 minutes, or 1000 kilowatts for 1 minute.

attributes.name: Charge
attributes.description: The current charge of the device.

attributes.name: MaxRechargeSpeed
attributes.description: How fast the device can be recharged. For example, a recharge speed of 100 kW and a capacity of 1000 kW*min would mean it takes 10 minutes to fully charge the device.

attributes.name: RechargeSpeed
attributes.description: The current recharge speed of the device.

attributes.name: ExponentialRechargeSpeed
attributes.description: If true, the recharge speed (and power consumption) of the device goes up exponentially as the recharge rate is increased.

attributes.name: Efficiency
attributes.description: The amount of power you can get out of a item relative to the amount of power that's put into it.

attributes.name: FlipIndicator
attributes.description: Should the progress bar indicating the charge be flipped to fill from the other side.

components.notes: 无用途说明句；继承（also supports）：Powered、ItemComponent

attributes.name: CanBeOverloaded
attributes.description: Can the item be damaged if too much power is supplied to the power grid.

attributes.name: OverloadVoltage
attributes.description: How much power has to be supplied to the grid relative to the load before item starts taking damage. E.g. a value of 2 means that the grid has to be receiving twice as much power as the devices in the...

attributes.name: FireProbability
attributes.description: The probability for a fire to start when the item breaks.

attributes.name: Overload
attributes.description: Is the item currently overloaded. Intended to be used by StatusEffect conditionals (setting the value from XML is not recommended).

attributes.name: MaxPower
attributes.description: The maximum amount of power that can pass through the item.

attributes.name: IsOn
attributes.description: Can the relay currently pass power and signals through it.

components.notes: 无用途说明句；继承（also supports）：PowerTransfer、Powered、ItemComponent

attributes.name: FlowPercentage
attributes.description: How fast the item is currently pumping water (-100 = full speed out, 100 = full speed in). Intended to be used by StatusEffect conditionals (setting this value in XML has no effect).

attributes.name: MaxFlow
attributes.description: How fast the item pumps water in/out when operating at 100%.

attributes.name: Disabled
attributes.description: If true, the pump is unable to pump water.

components.notes: 无用途说明句；继承（also supports）：Powered、ItemComponent

attributes.name: MaxPowerOutput
attributes.description: How much power (kW) the reactor generates when operating at full capacity.

attributes.name: MeltdownDelay
attributes.description: How long the temperature has to stay critical until a meltdown occurs.

attributes.name: FireDelay
attributes.description: How long the temperature has to stay critical until the reactor catches fire.

attributes.name: Temperature
attributes.description: Current temperature of the reactor (0% - 100%). Indended to be used by StatusEffect conditionals.

attributes.name: FissionRate
attributes.description: Current fission rate of the reactor (0% - 100%). Intended to be used by StatusEffect conditionals (setting the value from XML is not recommended).

attributes.name: TurbineOutput
attributes.description: Current turbine output of the reactor (0% - 100%). Intended to be used by StatusEffect conditionals (setting the value from XML is not recommended).

attributes.name: FuelConsumptionRate
attributes.description: How fast the condition of the contained fuel rods deteriorates per second.

attributes.name: TemperatureCritical
attributes.description: Is the temperature currently critical. Intended to be used by StatusEffect conditionals (setting the value from XML has no effect).

attributes.name: AutoTemp
attributes.description: Is the automatic temperature control currently on. Indended to be used by StatusEffect conditionals (setting the value from XML is not recommended).

attributes.name: Range
attributes.description: The maximum range of the sonar.

attributes.name: DetectSubmarineWalls
attributes.description: Should the sonar display the walls of the submarine it is inside.

attributes.name: UseTransducers
attributes.description: Does the sonar have to be connected to external transducers to work.

attributes.name: CenterOnTransducers
attributes.description: Should the sonar view be centered on the transducers or the submarine's center of mass. Only has an effect if UseTransducers is enabled.

attributes.name: HasMineralScanner
attributes.description: Does the sonar have mineral scanning mode.
